verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships an async Python API and a CLI (crwl) usable in scripts/CI, plus a Dockerized FastAPI server for headless deployment, all suited to automation pipelines. Community evidence corroborates real-world CI/production usage including Docker/n8n integration. Missing for 10: no direct CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions config) or explicit headless-mode flag documentation.
